## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has a test (a bug fix has one that fails without the fix)
- [ ] User-visible text goes through `src/i18n/`
- [ ] No keys, tokens, real project names or private `.leftoff/` content
- [ ] `docs/decisions.md` updated if this makes or reverses a design choice
